ann.t: General Updates — Receipt of RBI approval for appointment of MD & CEO of the Bank
Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about order passed by Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka

Outcome of Board Meeting — Fino Payments Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and outcome of the Board Meeting held on October 29, 2026.
Press Release — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "Un-audited Financial Results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — FINOPB: Fino Payments Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations —  Fino PayTech Limited  has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
General Updates — Fino Payments Bank Limited ( Bank ) announces strategic partnership with Ezee.ai to build lending eco-system for seamless Small Finance Bank ( SFB ) transition

Press Release — Submission of Press Release, inter alia, on the Audited Financial Results for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 and Un-audited Financial Results for the fourth quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Fino Payments Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Aashish Pathak as Chief Compliance Officer of the Bank w.e.f. March 31, 2026.
Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of the order by Hon'ble Court.

Press Release — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 29, 2026, titled "Press Release on the unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Fino Payments Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Appointment — Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Prayag Shashikant Gadgil as Internal Auditor of the company.
Action(s) initiated or orders passed — Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
